Annual Report 2024-25 (synthetic demo document for CLADES)
The Company delivered strong cash generation during the year and continued to invest in capacity.
Revenue grew 31 percent on the back of new orders. The Board is confident about the outlook.
Receivables rose because several large orders were billed in March.
During the year, the statutory auditors resigned and a new firm was appointed to fill the casual vacancy.
As on 31 March 2025, 45 percent of the shares held by the promoters have been pledged with lenders.

Key audit matters include revenue recognition, because of the volume of year-end billing.
The Company has not defaulted in repayment of loans or borrowings to any lender.
The Company has given loans to related parties aggregating Rs. 120.00 crore, which are repayable on demand.
